title: Provision local builder workspace: project-LICHEN/zephyr is a broken symlink (v3.7.0 tree absent on this box)
description: Found while attempting local native_sim build for 5fva.1. ~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN has a full local Zephyr env (SDK 0.16.8 at ~/Developer/zephyr-sdk, lichen-venv with west, env script ~/Developer/lichen-env.sh) BUT project-LICHEN/zephyr -> ../zephyr is a broken symlink (same defect as the Mac checkout, bead project-LICHEN-worker6-xplt) - the v3.7.0 zephyr clone is absent, so west build fails with 'workspace does not define extension command build' and ZEPHYR_BASE dangles. Fix: run west update in that workspace (manifest path lichen, west.yml pins v3.7.0) to clone zephyr + modules, or copy a known-good v3.7.0 tree in. After provisioning, native_sim builds can run locally without heft. Note: workspace checkout is at sync commit 50480b97e5, only .beads noise dirty.
